用安装时设的管理员账号登录。: Use the administrator account you set up during installation.
忘了密码：在服务器上运行: Forgot your password? On the server, run
， 拿一个不用密码的一次性链接。: to the bot for a one-time login link.
在策略项目里运行 quantbot link，接上后就会出现在这里。: Run quantbot link in the strategy project to connect it.
QuantBot 这次启动后发出的消息会显示在这里。: Notifications sent since QuantBot started appear here.
在网页或 Telegram 里点过的按钮会记在这里。: Actions taken in the web console or Telegram appear here.
{0} 个在线策略都不再开新仓。已有仓位和止损照常。: All {0} online strategies will pause new entries. Existing positions and stops remain active.
Telegram 没接，推送只显示在这个网页上。想在手机上收推送、点按钮，可以在: Telegram is disconnected. Notifications appear here. Connect Telegram in Settings to receive notifications and use controls on your phone.
添加策略可以生成连接令牌。也可以在策略项目里运行 quantbot link。: Add a strategy to create a connection token, or run quantbot link in the strategy project.
两次输入的新密码不同。: The new passwords do not match.
至少 8 位。保存后，其他会话需要重新登录。: Use at least 8 characters. Other sessions will need to sign in again.
请选中链接后手动复制。: Select and copy the link manually.
5 分钟内有效，可以登录一次。: Valid for 5 minutes and can be used once.
把这段话和你的策略代码一起交给 AI。里面有 QuantBot 的项目地址和具体: Share these instructions and your strategy code with your AI assistant. The instructions include the project links and connection steps.
小写字母、数字、- 和 _，例如 momentum: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores, for example momentum
网页和 Telegram 上显示的名字: Name shown in the web console and Telegram
已复制。贴给 AI，再附上你的策略代码。: Copied. Share the instructions and your strategy code with your AI assistant.
浏览器不让自动复制，请在框里全选后手动复制。: Select the text and copy it manually.
将 GitHub 上的新提交同步到编辑目录。拉取只在本地工作区干净、分支可以快进: Pull new commits from GitHub into the editor directory. The local working tree must be clean and the branch must allow a fast-forward.
将当前分支的已有提交推送到 GitHub。网页里保存的文件需要在服务器上提交后才: Push existing commits on this branch to GitHub. Commit files saved in the web editor on the server before pushing them.
从 QuantBot 移除这个仓库的授权凭据。: Remove this repository's authorization credentials from QuantBot.
打开 GitHub，输入验证码并授权访问仓库。: Open GitHub, enter the code, and authorize access to the repository.
填写 owner/repo 或 GitHub 仓库地址。: Enter owner/repo or a GitHub repository URL.
留空使用本地分支或仓库默认分支。: Leave blank to use the local branch or the repository default.
在 GitHub App 设置中启用设备授权，并将 App 安装到策略仓库。: Enable device authorization in the GitHub App settings and install the app on the strategy repository.
编辑目录为空时，授权后会将仓库克隆到该目录。: If the editor directory is empty, the repository will be cloned into it after authorization.
本地有未提交的改动，处理后可以拉取。: Commit or discard local changes before pulling.
当前未安装后台服务。可以在服务器上运行 quantbot service ins: No background service is installed. Run quantbot service install on the server.
QuantBot 会短暂断开，网页会自动重连。: The console will briefly disconnect and reconnect automatically.
Telegram 可以不接，只用网页。保存后 QuantBot 会自己重启一下。: Connect Telegram to receive notifications and use strategy controls on your phone.
在服务器上运行 quantbot setup 修改。: Run quantbot setup on the server to change this address.
想在手机上收推送、点按钮：在 @BotFather 发 /newbot 建一个: Send /newbot to @BotFather in Telegram. Message your new bot from your account, then fill in the fields below.
留空不改。: Leave blank to keep the current token.
现在是 {0}。只有这个账号能用 bot。: Current administrator: {0}. This account can control the bot.
只有这个账号能用 bot。可以向 @userinfobot 查询。: This account can control the bot. Use @userinfobot to find your ID.
例如 23-07。留空不设。: For example, 23-07. Leave blank to disable.
Healthchecks.io 的 ping 地址。留空不设。: Healthchecks.io ping URL. Leave blank to disable.
换 bot 或主人前，先用新账号给新 bot 发一条消息。保存时会发一条测试消息: Before changing the bot or administrator, send the new bot a message from the new administrator account. The settings are saved after a test message succeeds.
例如 momentum。使用小写字母、数字、- 或 _。: Use lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores, for example momentum.
请选中连接信息后手动复制。: Select and copy the connection details manually.
将从 QuantBot 移除 {0}，并撤销连接令牌。策略程序需要在服务器上单独: Remove {0} from QuantBot and revoke its connection token? The strategy process is managed on its own server.
旧令牌会立即失效。{0} 需要用新令牌重新连接。: The old token is revoked immediately. Reconnect {0} with the new token.
策略离线：命令会排队，2 分钟内它上线才会执行。: The strategy is offline. Commands are queued for up to 2 minutes.
这会让策略向券商下一个真实订单。: This submits a real order to the broker.
只会平它能确认归属的仓位。: Only verified positions belonging to this strategy will be closed.
程序会退出，挂着的止损单会保留。要再跑起来，得在服务器上启动它。: The process will exit and existing stop-loss orders will remain active. Start the strategy on its server to run it again.
已安装更新，等待 QuantBot 重启。: Update installed. Waiting for QuantBot to restart.
已经是最新版本: You are on the latest version
服务器找不到 uv。可以在服务器上重新运行安装命令来更新。: uv was not found on the server. Rerun the installer there to update QuantBot.
安装完成后，QuantBot 后台服务会重启，网页会自动重连。: The background service will restart after the update. The web console will reconnect automatically.
安装完成后，请在服务器上停止 QuantBot，再运行 quantbot run: After the update, stop QuantBot on the server and run quantbot run again.
连不上 QuantBot。网络或隧道断了，或者 QuantBot 没在运行。: Could not connect to QuantBot. Check the network, tunnel, or service status.
可以先在工作区绑定 GitHub 并准备代码，或添加策略获取连接令牌。: Use Workspace to connect GitHub and prepare your code, or add a strategy to get a connection token.
在运行 QuantBot 的服务器上选定目录后，即可在这里编辑代码并绑定 Git: Select a directory on the QuantBot server to edit files and connect GitHub here.
将当前分支的已有提交推送到 GitHub。保存的文件可以在「本地改动」中提交。: Push existing commits on this branch to GitHub. Commit saved files under Local changes.
工作区里还没有 Git 仓库。: There is no Git repository in the workspace yet.
连不上工作区终端，请检查服务器配置后重试。: Could not connect to the workspace terminal. Check the server configuration and retry.
在工作区目录运行。关闭浏览器后，后台程序会继续运行。: Runs in the workspace directory and stays active when you close the browser.
查看 QuantBot 服务状态和最近日志。: Inspect the QuantBot service and its recent logs.
网页初始化适用于以 root 运行的 Linux 服务器。其他环境可用 quan: Web setup requires a Linux server running QuantBot as root. In other environments, use quantbot editor on --root to select an editing directory.
请进入或新建一个空文件夹。: Open or create an empty folder.
选择一个空文件夹作为工作区。: Select an empty folder for the workspace.
初始化后，网页将打开所选目录。: The console will open the selected directory after setup.
GitHub 没有返回可用仓库。请将应用安装到目标仓库。: GitHub returned no repositories. Install the app on the repository you want to use.
首次使用时，在 GitHub 创建 QuantBot 应用，并为策略仓库授权。: Create the QuantBot app on GitHub and grant access to your strategy repository.
应用已登记。请在 GitHub 应用设置中启用 Device Flow，再安装到: The app is registered. Enable Device Flow in its GitHub settings, then install it on the repository.
在 GitHub 输入一次性授权码后，回到这里选择仓库。: Enter the one-time code on GitHub, then return to select a repository.
可填 github.com/apps/ 后的应用名称。: Use the app name after github.com/apps/.
磁盘上的文件已变更，草稿仍保留。: The file changed on disk. Your draft is still available.
请先保存或关闭此路径中的未保存文件。: Save or close unsaved files in this path first.
将当前分支的已有提交推送到远端。: Push existing commits on the current branch to the remote.
工作区中的文件和 Git 提交仍可在本地使用。: Your workspace files and Git commits remain available locally.
拉取只在本地工作区干净、分支可以快进时执行。: Pull requires a clean working tree and a fast-forward update.
请先提交或处理本地改动，再切换分支。: Commit or resolve local changes before switching branches.
请在服务器上安装 GitHub CLI（gh）。: Install GitHub CLI (gh) on the server.
请选择空目录或工作区账号拥有的项目目录。: Select an empty folder or a project owned by the workspace account.
选择要打开的项目目录。: Choose the project folder to open.
请等策略上线后再执行此操作。: Wait for the strategy to come online before running this action.
确认后，策略可恢复开仓。: The strategy may open positions after you confirm.
策略离线。暂停请求会保存，其他命令需要策略在线。: The strategy is offline. Pause requests are saved. Other commands require a connection.
确认策略已结束此操作，并在券商端核对结果后再填写。: Verify that the strategy has finished and check the outcome with the broker before submitting.
券商订单号或核对说明: Broker order ID or reconciliation note
选择工作区后，QuantBot 会写入模板并启动模拟策略。: Choose a workspace to save the template and start the paper strategy.
模拟策略已启动。现在可以在这里或 Telegram 试用策略按钮。: The paper strategy is running. Try its controls here or in Telegram.
启动模拟策略，试用网页和 Telegram 控制。: Start a paper strategy to try the Web and Telegram controls.
工作区程序启动时会收到独立的连接令牌。轮换后需重新启动程序。: The workspace program receives a dedicated connection token at launch. Restart it after rotating the token.
将关闭这个工作区并撤销其策略连接。服务器上的目录和文件会保留。: This closes the workspace and revokes its strategy connection. Its directory and files remain on the server.
